rewards.name: Trail Bombs
rewards.description: A bundle of twelve trail bombs. Use one to break a cracked stone wall. Each use consumes one bomb. Carry them carefully through the forest.

rewards.name: Red Tonic
rewards.description: Three bottles of red tonic. Drink one to restore your strength after a difficult journey. The bottle is consumed when used.

rewards.name: Field Notes
rewards.description:
These field notes were left by the last keeper of the western wood. The first chapter describes safe paths beside the river, while the second records the songs heard near the old bridge.

Read every page before setting out. Some paths change after rain. Look for pale stones at each crossing, and avoid the hollow tree after sunset. The keeper marked hidden shelters with three small leaves.

This reward is a single complete book. Its notes do not grant a spell, change your equipment, or use a consumable. Keep it as a guide for the next expedition.

Final note: take only what you need, leave a light for the next traveler, and return the book to the village archive when your journey ends. END OF FIELD NOTES.
